column3: NASB follows the critical text (“And who”).
NASB follows the critical text (“and with the blood”); it moves the last clause, “the Spirit is the one testifying …,” to verse 7.

NASB’s verse 7 contains the clause about the Spirit from the end of verse 6. Following the critical text, NASB omits the Textus Receptus words “in heaven: the Father, the Word, and the Holy Spirit; and these three are one.”
NASB follows the critical text, without “in earth”; “are in one” is rendered “are in agreement.”
NASB follows the critical text (“that”); “testimony” is rendered “witness.”
NASB follows the critical text, without the Textus Receptus repetition; it moves “who believe” forward.
NASB follows the critical text (“in whatever,” “from Him”).
NASB supplies “God”; “unto death” is rendered “leading to death,” and “implore” “make request.”
NASB follows the critical text (“keeps him”); “continues to sin” is rendered “sins.”
NASB follows the critical text, without “Amen”; “keep” is rendered “guard.”
